organisers.name: [{Braden Richards}{mailto:brichards@worldcubeassociation.org}] [{Keenan Darkins}{mailto:darkins.kb@gmail.com}] [{The Rubik's Cube Club at Ohio State}{mailto:ohiostatecubeclub@gmail.com}]

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmxpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c86e194a19a736417f928c3661c57e4d700acb44/0.png) This competition takes place on a **Tuesday Evening** and will only feature 3x3x3 Fewest Moves and 3x3x3 Blindfolded. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio.](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list) Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.
